newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for meat-processing firm.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for meat-processing firm.

text.p: The Polish privatisation ministry invited bids for up to 55 percent in the meat-processing firm Zaklady Miesne Miestar SA based in Tarnow, south-eastern Poland, the ministry said in a newspaper announcement.
The ministry said it invited bids for at least 10 percent stakes in the firm by September 27.
It said it earmarked up to 20 percent of the company's shares for employees, 20 percent for farm producers cooperating with the company and five percent for reprivatisation claims.
The ministry declined to give any further details and no one at the company was immediatley available for comment.
